description: Book a 60-minute consultation with a Pactum lawyer, prepaid (the price is in the response; it is credited toward the service if the client orders it). Call ONLY after the user asked for a consultation, accepted the price, gave their real name and phone, and agreed that Pactum stores these details. Returns the order number, price, how to pay and a status link. For a price quote on a whole task use request_quote instead.

agent_name.description: Your assistant name, e.g. ChatGPT, Claude

contact_name.description: Client name as the user gave it

preferred_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, Tashkent time; a lawyer confirms

service_slug.description: Slug from search_services, if a specific service fits

topic.description: What the user wants to discuss, in their own terms

user_accepts_price.description: true only if the user agreed to pay for the consultation

user_consent.description: true only if the user explicitly agreed to share these details with Pactum and its partner lawyer

name: book_consultation
title: Book a paid consultation with a lawyer
